calculation.description: Compute 40-session log momentum divided by downside semideviation estimated over 60 sessions, winsorize cross-sectionally at the 10th and 90th percentiles, convert to cross-sectional percentile rank, and smooth for three sessions. Positive raw values indicate momentum, but the validated forecast direction is negative (reversal). All inputs are lag-safe at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Negative IC is economically interpretable as a reversal direction; strongest negative performance was recent (365d IC -0.073566, ICIR -0.235103). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
